response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile is a poor match for this role's mandatory requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 (C/C++ components for LabWindows/CVI) plus an academic project, far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on C++ required, and there is no evidence of Windows-platform systems development at scale. SQL appears only as a generic skill listing with MySQL/MongoDB, with no SQL Server or Oracle exposure. Domain fit is also missing: the closest financial experience is RIDE Capital (a German investment/fintech startup) built in Node/TypeScript/GraphQL, which does not constitute fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking/capital-markets systems knowledge. Strengths in D, TypeScript, testing culture, and CI/CD are desirable-only extras that cannot offset the unmet core criteria.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering track record across web, mobile, embedded, and low-latency systems
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development, open-source test tooling
Proven low-latency, high-throughput backend work (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience versus the 5–10 years required
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; database background is MongoDB/MySQL
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking/capital-markets domain exposure
